summary: Andretti Acquisition Corp. II, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K to disclose additional non-redemption agreements entered into with new investors. Under these agreements, the sponsor and company agreed to issue up to 900,000 Pubco shares (or 300,000 more if business combination closes after June 9, 2027) in exchange for investors not redeeming up to 3,600,000 public shares. This is a routine SPAC extension-meeting activity, not a special-situation event.
